'''Del Hunter''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] businessman from [[Kabaira]]. He worked for [[Delgas Medical]] but eventually joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. His son, [[Chaz Hunter|Chaz]] was also a Rebel.<ref name="Passages" />
